note: E2 biome reinforcements: the kind a vent releases is reinforce[(wave + vent) % size], wave = the index of this spawn in the floor's smog schedule, vent = the vent's index in map.vents. Two vents, two waves, list [drill_bot, rust_hound]: wave 0 releases drill then hound, wave 1 hound then drill. Hardcoding drill_bot fails pattern 2 (no hound at (7, 3) at all); dropping the vent term (wave 0 drill, drill; wave 1 hound, hound) or the wave term (both waves drill then hound) fails pattern 3: neither puts a hound at (1, 3) AFTER a hound at (7, 3), which is what the in-order match needs.
